in_hebrew.name: Chane
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is gracious
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Chane הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Chane is derived from the Hebrew language and is composed of two elements: Chan, meaning 'God,' and Ach, meaning 'grace' or 'favor.' The name Chane signifies that God is gracious and shows favor to those who bear this name.
